description: Single source of truth for model IDs. parallel-review selects offline review tiers (1..2; unspecified/auto means L1), each with exactly two Pi reviewers in Codex then Claude order. Tier attempt budgets live in reviewTimeouts. Claude and OpenAI handle normal review and implementation; Grok is reserved for research. The `oss.*` roles are separate, explicitly opted-in Meta routes and are not used by normal workflows. Roles name one model per consumer: .pi for Pi headless, .agy for Antigravity CLI (resolve with --field agy), .cursor for Cursor Agent CLI (resolve with --field cursor), .id for other tools such as Codex.

oss.impl.label: Muse Spark Contributor OSS implementation (explicit opt-in)

oss.review.label: Muse Spark Contributor OSS patch review (explicit opt-in)
